   CONGRATULATIONS!
 On your 2019 Southern California Regional Heptathlon Championship and the 2019
South Coast Conference Heptathlon Championship. The City Council also extends our
 sincere congratulations on your academic accomplishments; Dean’s list at Cerritos
  College as well as receiving full scholarship offers from three universities.

  DARLENA DIANE ROBINSON

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!
  COMMEMORATING SENATE BILL S-1050 RESOLUTION
 For all your efforts in organizing a national campaign known as the Chinese American
 World War II Veterans Recognition Project to honor Chinese-American who served in
 World War II. On December 20, 2018, President Trump signed into law Senate Bill S-
1050 titled the Chinese-American World War II Veteran Congressional Gold Medal Act.

  CHINESE AMERICAN CITIZEN ALLIANCE

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!
 For offering free tax return services at the Monterey Park Langley Senior Center on
  February 17, 2019 the City Council extends our sincere appreciation.
